inputs.text: Black spade marks ONLY on him; red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Surrealist oil painting in the style of Salvador Dali, meticulous classical hyper-detail: the spade king with silver-grey hair, spade crown and spade-marked armor and the diamond queen with very long red-orange hair, tiara and diamond-marked gown stand at a card table where small drawers hang ajar from the table edge and from their own sleeves, a wooden crutch props up a giant melting playing card above them, drawer handles gleaming, twilight desert visible through seven open doorways behind, elongated shadows, earth tones with deep blue dusk and golden highlights, dreamlike paranoiac atmosphere
